title: Meta releases open weights for an LLM-JEPA text embedding model
text: Meta releases open weights for an LLM-JEPA text embedding model under Apache-2.0, with training code on GitHub. The checkpoint is a joint embedding predictive architecture for text.

title: What is JEPA? A short explainer
text: A blog post explaining what JEPA is and how joint embedding predictive architectures differ from generative models. No weights and no code release.

title: University lab releases a 7B open-weight language model
text: A university lab released a new 7B open-weight language model on Hugging Face under Apache-2.0. The weights and inference code are public. This is a standard transformer, not a JEPA model.

title: Kev 0.8B open decision model released for Apple Silicon
text: Kev 0.8B, an Apache-2.0 decision model, was released for local Apple Silicon. It answers System One noul, choice, and score questions and returns calibrated probabilities.

title: Commission proposes an AI Act amendment on open-weight models
text: The European Commission proposed an amendment to the AI Act regulating open-weight models. The regulation is scheduled for a vote. An AI Act amendment mentions open-weight models but no weights were released.

title: New paper reports state-of-the-art on MMLU
text: A new paper reports state-of-the-art results on the MMLU benchmark and calls the result a new SOTA for knowledge tests.

title: LLM-JEPA checkpoints now public
text: Researchers at Meta have published Apache-2.0 checkpoints and training code for a text JEPA model they call LLM-JEPA.

title: Lakers defeat Celtics in overtime
text: The Lakers defeated the Celtics 118-114 in overtime behind a late run. Playoff seeding remains unchanged.

title: Machine learning conference opens in Vienna
text: A conference schedule mentions talks and datasets but no new results. No model release was announced.
